description: Paths under the install root that must survive version updates. Relative to content root (same folder as KonkoorHelp.Api.dll).
notes: Ship/update may replace sandbox/appsettings.defaults.json and PRESERVE.manifest.json.
Never overwrite sandbox/appsettings.json during robocopy /MIR — use install-rotbeh.ps1.
On startup, missing keys from appsettings.defaults.json are merged into appsettings.json without clobbering existing values.
